verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a free migration app that moves code and users from Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Cloud, and a community member mentions importing repos. Nothing shows issues, pull requests, reviews, or comments being carried over, or any import from a third-party host. missing for 10: import from other hosting platforms (e.g., GitHub/GitLab), migration of issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, independent hands-on corroboration of metadata-preserving migration.
